comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals this sequence is most similar (85.7%) to Temporin-HB2. Activity: S. aureus MRSA (MIC 4 uM), E. faecalis (MIC 16 uM), E.coli (MIC >128 uM), P.aeruginosa (MIC >128 uM), K.pneumoniae (MIC >128 uM). MRSA biofilms (MBIC/MBEC 4/16 uM) Structure: More helical in anionic lipids (42%) than in zwitterionic lipids (28%). Even more helical in 50% TFE (59%). MOA: membrane permeation. In vitro Toxicity: HC50: 64-128 uM. Reg.7/2021
reference_text: Int J Mol Sci. 2021 Apr 26;22(9):4509. doi: 10.3390/ijms22094509. PubMed
